name: Russia
title: The Tsardom of Russia
pressure_shape: Explorers and Beasts: Explorers +1 Damage and Beast hunting (L1), Explorers Pushed instead of Destroyed (L2), Ravage in lands with 3+ Explorers (L3), a Stage III card after each Stage II (L4), Invader cards in the Fear Deck (L5); loses if Beasts Destroyed by adversary rules exceed Beasts on the island.

stage_ii_escalation.title: Stalk the Predators
stage_ii_escalation.text: On each board: Add 2 Explorer (total) among lands with Beast. If you can’t, instead add 2 Explorer among lands with Beast on a different board.

loss_condition.title: Hunters Swarm the Island
loss_condition.text: Track Beast Destroyed by Adversary rules. If that number ever exceeds the number of Beast on the island, the Invaders win.

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (TheTsardomOfRussia), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.6 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Stalk the Predators): On each board: Add 2 Explorer (total) among lands with Beast. If you can’t, instead add 2 Explorer among lands with Beast on a different board. Additional loss condition (Hunters Swarm the Island): Track Beast Destroyed by Adversary rules. If that number ever exceeds the number of Beast on the island, the Invaders win.
levels.notes: R-ADV-RUS-L0a, R-ADV-RUS-L0b. Escalation happens before Exploring (Wiki ruling); it adds Explorers, which are never Explore sources (NQ-G).

levels.name: Hunters Seek Shell and Hide
levels.escalation: During Setup, on each board, add 1 Beast and 1 Explorer to the highest-numbered land without Town/City. During Play, Explorer do +1 Damage. When Ravage adds Blight to a land (including cascades), Destroy 1 Beast in that land.
levels.notes: R-ADV-RUS-L1a, R-ADV-RUS-L1b, R-ADV-RUS-L1c. Engine title 'Hunters Seek Shell and Hide'; Wiki title 'Hunters Bring Home Shell and Hide' (box title not confirmed).

levels.name: A Sense for Impending Disaster
levels.escalation: The first time each Action would Destroy Explorer: If possible, 1 of those Explorer is instead Pushed; 1 Fear when you do so.

levels.name: Competition Among Hunters
levels.escalation: Ravage Cards also match lands with 3 or more Explorer. (If the land already matched the Ravage Card, it still Ravages just once per Card. )

levels.name: Accelerated Exploitation
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, put 1 Stage III Card after each Stage II Card. (New Deck Order: 111-2-3-2-3-2-3-2-33)

levels.name: Entrench in the Face of Fear
levels.escalation: Put an unused Stage II Invader Card under the top 3 Fear Cards, and an unused Stage III Card under the top 7 Fear Cards. When one is revealed, immediately place it in the Build space (face-up).
levels.notes: R-ADV-RUS-L5a, R-ADV-RUS-L5b. The two cards are taken face down from the cards left over after the whole Invader Deck is built; they are Invader Cards, not Fear Cards. The Stage II card is exposed by earning the 3rd Fear Card, the Stage III by the 7th; it triggers its Escalation when first resolved (Brett, Q20).

levels.name: Pressure for Fast Profit
levels.escalation: After the Ravage Step of turn 2+, on each board where it added no Blight: In the land with the most Explorer (min. 1), add 1 Explorer and 1 Town.
